lines.speaker: A
lines.english: Excuse me, what time is it now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 谢谢。我要去上班，还有时间吗？
lines.pinyin: Xièxie. Wǒ yào qù shàngbān, hái yǒu shíjiān ma?
lines.english: Thanks. I'm going to work. Is there still time?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, nín hái yǒu sānshí fēnzhōng.
lines.english: Yes, you still have thirty minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ xiān hē bēi chá.
lines.english: Then I'll drink a cup of tea first.
